newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria Nat'l Bank allots 5.15 bln ATS in repos.
newsitem.headline: Austria Nat'l Bank allots 5.15 bln ATS in repos.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank said on Friday it had allocated 5.15 billion schillings in one-week securities repurchase agreements, or repos, at a fixed rate of three percent, unchanged from last week.
The central bank said seven percent of bids were filled.
Last week, the bank allotted 7.07 billion schillings, or seven percent of bids, in repos. -- Julia Ferguson, Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254
